title: NORTHWIND TEA
prompt: Some mornings start slowly | A plain black tea | Dried slowly. Packed the same week. | NORTHWIND - take the long way

line: Some mornings you need the day to start slowly. Northwind is a plain black tea. No claims, no ceremony. Grown on a hillside, dried slowly, packed the same week. Northwind. Take the long way through the morning.
